title: Ondo quote carousel
description: A sliding row of testimonial cards from the left margin: the current card is black with a rounded portrait, the person's name and role, a plain-text company name in the corner and a long serif quote at its foot; the cards either side are shorter, pale grey and muted. Square arrow buttons below slide the row and pass the black to the next card.
notes: media slot: a 100×100 portrait per quote; a plain surface when empty
the current card forces the theme's dark colours with the dark class
quotes read var(--ondo-serif) and fall back to the display face in other themes
name: ondo-testimonials
